stemMd: An organism has genotype AaBb, with the loci on different chromosomes. Which gamete frequencies are expected without segregation distortion?

options.label: A
options.textMd: AB, Ab, aB and ab each at one quarter

options.label: B
options.textMd: Aa and Bb each at one half

options.label: D
options.textMd: A, a, B and b as separate complete gametes

options.label: E
options.textMd: AB and ab only, each at one half

explanationMd: Each locus contributes either allele with probability one half. Independent assortment gives four combinations, each with probability one half times one half, or one quarter.

distractorRationale.e: This ignores independent assortment of unlinked loci.
distractorRationale.c: This would require only dominant alleles in every gamete.
distractorRationale.d: Each gamete carries both loci, not only one.
distractorRationale.b: Gametes contain one allele from each locus, not homologous pairs.
